growth_signal.value: Named a top Swedish startup by 33-listan two years in a row (2020).

entry.idea: Big companies buy lots of market research but staff cannot find it later, so Stravito puts it all in one searchable place.
entry.lesson: Take something every big company already pays for, then fix the part where it gets lost or wasted.
entry.name: Stravito

growth.reason: No revenue or customer numbers in the sources, only older funding and awards.

market.reason: Nearly every large company buys market research, so the profession is global.

tech.reason: Useful search and sharing software, but a good team could build similar tools in months.
